mapper.sql: WHERE p.deleted=0 AND p.creator_id=#{userId} AND p.status=#{status}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*,o.name AS org_name,u.display_name AS creator_name,co.name AS current_org_name FROM project p JOIN organization o ON o.id=p.org_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=p.creator_id LEFT JOIN approval_step cs ON cs.id=p.current_step_id LEFT JOIN organization co ON co.id=cs.org_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project p JOIN project_submission r ON r.project_id=p.id

SELECT p.id,r.project_code,COALESCE(r.project_name,'升级前材料（未保存快照）') AS project_name, r.amount,r.material,p.creator_id,r.org_id,r.org_name,r.submitter_name AS creator_name, r.status,r.round_no,r.round_no AS visible_round_no,p.version,p.deleted,p.created_at,p.updated_at, CASE WHEN p.round_no=r.round_no THEN p.current_step_id ELSE NULL END AS current_step_id, CASE WHEN p.round_no=r.round_no THEN co.name ELSE NULL END AS current_org_name FROM project p JOIN project_submission r ON r.project_id=p.id LEFT JOIN approval_step cs ON cs.id=p.current_step_id LEFT JOIN organization co ON co.id=cs.org_id ORDER BY r.round_no DESC,p.updated_at DESC,p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM project WHERE id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.*,o.name AS org_name,u.display_name AS creator_name,co.name AS current_org_name FROM project p JOIN organization o ON o.id=p.org_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=p.creator_id LEFT JOIN approval_step cs ON cs.id=p.current_step_id LEFT JOIN organization co ON co.id=cs.org_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND p.deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET project_code=#{projectCode},project_name=#{projectName},amount=#{amount},material=#{material}, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0 AND status IN ('DRAFT','REJECTED')
UPDATE project SET deleted=1,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0 AND status='DRAFT' AND round_no=0
UPDATE project SET status=#{status},round_no=#{roundNo},current_step_id=#{stepId},version=version+1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0
